chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played All Streams Flow to the Sea, then both copies of Water's Edge, all targeting Sludge Spinner. With 8 Charge, that deals 13 + 6 + 6 damage, enough to defeat its 24 HP.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Itto - Superlative Guard for 14 damage and 6 Block, which would leave Sludge Spinner alive at 10 HP and reduce the incoming 8 damage to 2.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up the 6 Block from Itto - Superlative Guard, but ending the fight made that protection unnecessary against the declared attack.
answers.q4_different_intent: No. The three one-energy attacks provide lethal damage, so a different telegraphed intent would not have changed my line.
